name: multi-step-form
title: Multi Step Form
description: One form, a few steps, a last look before it is sent: a booking flow (when, who, check), a sign-up, a request. Every step is a real part of one `<form>`, kept in the page and hidden while it is not the current one, so what the reader typed survives going…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/multi-step-form

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/multi-step-form.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/multi-step-form';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/multi-step-form

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
